title: Operating the Torion® T-9 Portable Gas Chromatograph-Mass Spectrometer for Animal Scent Analysis
author: Alice C. Poirier
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.brpqm5mw
materials: Material: Individually numbered clean glass vials with screw-top and silicone septa lids in a cardboard box Bag of sterile cotton bud swabs Eppendorf tubes filled with distilled water Two Thermos ® flasks filled with ice packs

Sampling procedure: Take the swab out of its wrapping Wet swab it in distilled water Rub swab against surface to sample (someone else must hold the animal for easier access to it), five times in an up-and-down movement Open vial and insert swab, break the stem and close the lid; ensure swab does not touch any other surface before being stored in the vial, in which case the swab should be discarded and a new sample collected Call out sample type and vial number Store vial in Thermos ® flask Repeat sampling procedure for all glands and skin on each animal

On computer: Open Chromion ® software Connect to Torion ® instrument, wait for connection to happen GC and MS methods can be modified in Chromion ® , then sent to instrument (see Methods presented in article main text)
SAMPLE ANALYSIS (example fo a single sample)

steps.title: Prepare Initial Materials
steps.instruction: Prepare the following items before processing each animal:

substeps.instruction: Place 20 vials on a tray
Prepare 20 swabs ready to open
Prepare one tube of distilled water

steps.title: Initialize Instrument Hardware
steps.instruction: Set up the Torion T-9 hardware and gas supply.

substeps.instruction: Turn on the generator (refill if necessary prior to starting)
Open the helium tank valve, monitor the helium level on the gauge, and record it in the log
Remove the white gas cap from behind the instrument
Check the electrical connection
Remove side covers (unless conditions are very cold and humid)
Remove the injector cover

steps.title: Start Software and System
steps.instruction: Boot the instrument and establish operational parameters.

substeps.instruction: Press the start button and wait for start up
Open Chromion software on the touchscreen
Select the 'GCMS' icon on the touchscreen and wait until ready to establish vacuum and oven temperature
Connect the computer using the red interface cable

steps.title: Perform System Quality Checks
steps.instruction: Assess the cleanliness of the instrument and SPME fiber.

substeps.instruction: Run one or two system blanks by selecting the 'system blank' category on the touchscreen to assess the column, injector, and ion trap
If the system blank shows contamination, perform a bake run (empty blank run at 320°C); a bake run method can be created in Chromion
Perform a fiber blank by selecting the 'sample' category and injecting the fiber as a normal sample; verify that the baseline is low and no important peaks are present

If the fiber is dirty, clean it by inserting it into the injector for 15-30 seconds (select 'sample' on the touchscreen but ignore the injection message). If this is done, run one or several fiber blanks afterward until the baseline is clear

steps.title: Prepare Extraction Materials
steps.instruction: Gather materials before removing samples from the freezer:

substeps.instruction: Custodion SPME syringe
Sterile disposable syringe and needle
Sterile paper wipes
Pan of simmering water

steps.title: Extract Sample via SPME
steps.instruction: Extract animal scent from the vial using the SPME fiber.

substeps.instruction: Tighten the vial cap if necessary
Immerse approximately half of the vial in simmering water for 2 minutes
Quickly remove the vial from the water bath and wipe condensation off the lid
Pierce the lid septum with the syringe needle
Insert the SPME needle, ensuring it does not touch the swab
Under a light, carefully expose the fiber for 2 minutes without touching the swab or vial edges
Retract the SPME fiber

steps.title: Analyze Sample and Log Data
steps.instruction: Inject the sample into the GCMS and record the results.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the Torion touchscreen is set to the 'sample' category and press 'run'
Remove the SPME needle from the vial and insert it into the injector, following the touchscreen instructions for fiber exposure and removal
Record sample information in the sample log
Note: While data is processing, another vial can be heated and extracted
Run a fiber blank every few samples to ensure cleanliness; bake fiber if necessary

steps.title: Shut Down and Store
steps.instruction: Properly power down the system and store components.

substeps.instruction: Backup all data from the Torion SD card onto the computer
Turn off the instrument
Close the helium valve (only after the instrument is off to avoid interrupting the vacuum system)
Store the SPME fiber in a tight box protected from humidity and ambient air
